**Bottom line**  
Strongly positive. In 2024 Biden did not try to cling to office, accepted the electoral result, and followed normal succession/transition rules. The main supporting evidence is his withdrawal from the race, his endorsement of Harris, and his post-election transition remarks. I found no credible Biden-specific evidence of term-limit evasion or constitutional transfer sabotage.

| Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| [Biden drops out of 2024 race after disastrous debate inflamed age concerns, VP Harris gets his nod](https://www.ap.org/news-highlights/elections/2024/biden-drops-out-of-2024-race-after-disastrous-debate-inflamed-age-concerns-vp-harris-gets-his-nod/) | Associated Press | 2024-07-21 | https://www.ap.org/news-highlights/elections/2024/biden-drops-out-of-2024-race-after-disastrous-debate-inflamed-age-concerns-vp-harris-gets-his-nod/ | Biden exited the reelection race under pressure and endorsed Harris, which is direct evidence that he did not try to cling to the ticket or bypass normal succession within his party. | `4B.8`, `4B.1` |
| [Address to the Nation on the 2024 Presidential Election](https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/address-the-nation-the-2024-presidential-election) | The American Presidency Project | 2024-11-07 | https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/address-the-nation-the-2024-presidential-election | Biden congratulated Trump, said power changes through peaceful elections, and directed his administration to cooperate on an orderly transition. This is the clearest evidence that he respected constitutional transfer of power. | `4B.8`, `4B.1` |
| [Was Biden dropping out of the race a coup by Democrats?](https://www.politifact.com/article/2024/jul/24/was-biden-dropping-out-of-the-race-a-coup-by-democ/) | PolitiFact / AP | 2024-07-24 | https://www.politifact.com/article/2024/jul/24/was-biden-dropping-out-of-the-race-a-coup-by-democ/ | Legal experts said replacing Biden on the ticket was lawful and not a coup. This supports the view that the succession change stayed inside constitutional and party rules. | `4B.8` |
| [Biden signs stopgap bundle that avoids a shutdown](https://apnews.com/article/853b90ae025108be4ee98b939facd913) | Associated Press | 2024-03-09 | https://apnews.com/article/853b90ae025108be4ee98b939facd913 | Biden signed a stopgap package that kept government open despite divided control, showing respect for legislative bargaining and coalition constraints rather than trying to bypass them. | `4B.8` |
| [Biden signs large bipartisan aid package for Ukraine, Israel, Taiwan and Indo-Pacific](https://apnews.com/article/b72aed9b195818735d24363f2bc34ea4) | Associated Press | 2024-04-24 | https://apnews.com/article/b72aed9b195818735d24363f2bc34ea4 | Biden signed a major bipartisan package through Congress, which is evidence of working within coalition commitments and legislatively negotiated power-sharing. | `4B.8` |
| [Biden breaks silence on college protests over Gaza conflict](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/biden-breaks-silence-on-college-protests-over-gaza-conflict-3415253) | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-05-02 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/biden-breaks-silence-on-college-protests-over-gaza-conflict-3415253 | Biden publicly affirmed the right to demonstrate while insisting on lawful order; this is not a transfer-of-power issue, but it is consistent with a broader pattern of staying inside constitutional and procedural rules. | `4B.8`, `4B.3` |

**Search gap**  
I found no credible Biden-specific 2024 evidence that he tried to override term limits, alter succession rules, or obstruct the constitutional transfer of power. The strongest available material is positive; the remaining caution is only that internal party pressure forced the withdrawal, but that still happened through lawful party and constitutional procedures.
